rca_of_issue: RESOLVED. Both iter82 P1 issues were addressed at the right layer: (1) Mixed-content RCA: request.base_url returned the internal http://cluster URL because uvicorn behind ingress sees scheme='http' on the upstream socket. Fix combined a server-side helper (_public_base honoring X-Forwarded-Host → https, with PUBLIC_APP_URL env fallback) AND a client-side fallback in loader.js (deriveRoot from document.currentScript.src origin), so the iframe ROOT is always correct even on third-party HTTPS partner sites. Demo-host additionally uses a relative <script src> so it inherits the page scheme. (2) WA-gate RCA: org-auth login bypassed setting whatsapp_verified on the user document and didn't return it; the global gate then treated the org-member as unverified. Fix sets whatsapp_verified=true on both /login (frictionless) and /verify-otp paths, returns it in the user response, and the demo seed persists it — so /tools/* is no longer hijacked to /whatsapp-verify.
